quote: The butler arrived with the day's ledger and a quietled face. He moved as he always did through the apartment: a practised economy of gait, a carriage of small ceremonies.
He laid the ledger on the table and, without being asked, set out the note of luncheon possibilities in his careful hand.
The butler arrived with the day's ledger and a quietled face.
"We will make provisions. I will keep the household flexible. The kitchen will put together something—sliced cold chicken, open sandwiches and fruit—should you return hungry.
"We shall keep the household flexible," he said, and when the Queen looked at him he added, quieter, "The kitchen will have a small cold tray ready should Your Majesty return hungry."
